channel.title: EduByte
channel.description: Deep dives into AI, ML, and software engineering — written by Ayush Singh Rathor.

item.title: Can AI Actually Be Creative?
item.description: Exploring the line between generation and genuine creativity — and where AI tools actually fit in.

item.title: Can We Trust AI-Generated Information?
item.description: A closer look at verification, sourcing, and why fact-checking still matters in the age of generative text.

item.title: Why Does AI "Lie"? Understanding Hallucination in Large Language Models
item.description: An exploration into why confident AI models generate false citations, made-up facts, and plausible-sounding errors — and how to handle them.

item.title: AI Myths and Facts: Separating What's Real from the Hype
item.description: From JEE preparation to AI prompts, exploring the reality of Artificial Intelligence behind sci-fi tropes, hallucinations, and mainstream hype.
